errors.evidence: The description incorrectly reports the coordinates of the data points for the 'Delay' line. The x-coordinates are not at the major tick marks (0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5) but at approximately 0.25, 0.38, 0.43, and 0.48. Furthermore, several y-values are misreported; for instance, at x≈0.38, the accuracy is ≈75 (not 73), and at x≈0.43, the accuracy is ≈74 (not 72).
